title: Loot Rarity
description: Inspirated from an outdated mod, a fully redesigned loot rarity mod that is indicated by beams of light from the items on the ground.  Fully customizable!
body:
Inspirated from an outdated mod, a fully redesigned loot rarity mod that is indicated by beams of light from the items on the ground.  Fully customizable!

You can choose which items fall under certain colours.  

Perfect for RPG worlds!
